item.title: Parade of fronts lead to temperature ups and downs through the weekend
item.description: The area experienced a warm day with temperatures reaching near 60°, but the pattern will feature frequent fronts leading to more ups and downs through the weekend, with temperatures ranging from the teens to the 50s.

item.title: Springfield’s forgotten UFO? The bizarre 1897 airship seen over Missouri
item.description: SPRINGFIELD, Mo. — In the spring of 1897, residents across southwest Missouri described sightings of a mysterious “airship” — a craft they said resembled a giant mechanical dragonfly and appeared to drift silently over trains, towns and backyards. item.title: Pet adoptions surge for Christmas, so does the cost to care for one

item.title: Last week’s Springfield restaurant health code violations, Dec. 1-5
item.description: Out of 52 restaurants inspected in Springfield, Missouri from Dec. 1-5, 2025, 6 priority violations were found, as well as 22 priority violations and 23 nonpriority violations at various other establishments, all of which were corrected on site.
